metadata.description: US venture capital annual totals (NVCA/PitchBook Venture Monitor)
metadata.primary_source: PitchBook-NVCA Venture Monitor Q1 2026 (most recent; includes retroactive revisions)
metadata.notes: Annual figures are revised across report editions as PitchBook confirms more deals. Values here are from the Q1-2026 report (most recent), which has the best retrospective coverage. Deal counts vary significantly across editions.

data.source: NVCA Q1-2026 annual chart. Note: Q4-2025 report shows $149.5B/15,250 deals for 2020 — significant discrepancy. 2020 deal count is unusually high in Q1-2026 edition, possibly reflecting different angel/micro-VC inclusion.
NVCA Q1-2026 annual chart. Consistent across reports ($358.1–358.7B range).

NVCA Q1-2026 annual chart. Note: Q4-2025 shows $168.8B; Q2-2025 shows $164.7B. Deal count also varies significantly (14,090–17,021) across reports.
NVCA Q1-2026 annual chart. Consistent range $212.6–215.4B across reports.
NVCA Q4-2025 report (full-year final). Q1-2026 report shows $321.6B — revision in progress. Use $339.4B as more complete figure from the dedicated annual report.
